answer: Each key must operate one dedicated 1-Mbps uplink for 15 epochs and answer seven beacon-timed packet challenges per epoch from four independent relays. Validators verify relay signatures and compare jitter/loss fingerprints; keys sharing six of seven rare patterns merge. A jetty may border a terrace at dawn, but every extra fake needs another uplink and 105 timely replies, so 1,000 clones require 1 Gbps and 105,000 proofs. Two missed rounds erase rewards, slash a 105-credit bond, and freeze linked keys for six epochs.
